page.overview:
Who is Briana de Sepulveda?

Following the death of her husband, and in spite of his family's attempts to nullify the will, Briana inherited the entirety of the de Sepulveda estate. In an unprecedented turn of events, she also took over management of the family's extremely lucrative fur tanneries, soaking and stitching workshops and furrieries in Novigrad.

At some point around , Briana's daughter Xymena was abducted by an aguara, much to her despair. Though she did not outwardly display it, Briana was distraught at the loss of her only child but didn't ask for help. However, the merchants' guild, wanting to end her despair, got together and funded a rescue expedition, spearheaded by the merchant Kevenard van Vliet on board his ship, the Prophet Lebioda. Ultimately the rescue mission was botched, and instead of Xymena they managed to abduct a different she-fox altogether, prompting chase by its own aguara mother.
